title: Cross Site Scripting/Injection in PageTab.jsp in Apache JSPWIKI versions 2.10 through 3.0.0 on all platforms allows an…
description: Apache JSPWIKI versions 2.10 through 3.0.0 contain a Cross Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the PageTab.jsp component. This flaw allows attackers to craft malicious wiki pages and share URLs that bypass HTML and JavaScript encoding, resulting in script execution in users' browsers. The issue is fixed in version 3.0.1.
